title: Isolate MemoryChangePublisher handler failures per subscriber
description: P2 — MemoryChangePublisher.PublishAsync uses Task.WhenAll which throws on first fault; AuditAndPublishAsync doesn't catch the exception. A failing subscriber (e.g., a misbehaving event handler) crashes the entire memory create/update/delete operation, not just that subscriber. Fix: wrap each handler invocation in try-catch that logs the error and continues, preventing one subscriber from cascading failure. Found in 10-agent codebase audit 2026-07-10 (P1-012).
